The BM25 file router beats the filename-keyword baseline on held-out pull requests, so the change is in draft PR https://github.com/vitalitychems-dot/TESSERA/pull/271.

`data/rea/registry.json` is not in the repo, so `artifacts/v2/src/brain/router.mjs` ranks the workspace module list (source files under `artifacts/`, `lib/`, and `scripts/`). There was no file router to compare against. `artifacts/v2/src/token/router.mjs` only picks a sim model, so the baseline is keyword overlap on path tokens.

The eval was frozen before tuning. It uses closed TESSERA pull-request titles and bodies, with the files those PRs actually changed as ground truth. Requests whose changed files still exist in the module list, and that touch 1 to 12 of those files, were kept: 88 requests, split 44/44 by pull-request number. Only the dev half was used to set `filenameMix` to 1.1.
